No text, no watermark, no logo, no Japanese elements, no kimono, no samurai, no generic hanfu, no cheap costume, no plastic skin.

Foreground: one central model wearing a newly designed danjiao phoenix crown hairstyle with black forehead hair patches, blue-white-pink pearl crown, red pom-poms, tassels; behind her two blurred supporting models show lingzi arc and red martial dan variations. This must look like a new commercial design proposal for a real experience?, not a stage performance still.
